description: This PHP source file defines the SystemCheckException class within the OrangeHRM installer exception namespace. It provides custom exception methods to indicate missing PHP extensions required for system checks during installation.

classes.name: SystemCheckException
classes.description: Custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, providing specific static methods to generate exceptions related to missing PHP extensions.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOExtension
methods.description: Returns an instance of SystemCheckException with a message indicating the PDO extension is not enabled.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOMySQLDriver
methods.description: Returns an instance of SystemCheckException with a message indicating the pdo_mysql extension is not enabled.
